content.short: SolanaFloor is a data analysis platform for Solana.
content.description: SolanaFloor, founded in 2021, is a data analysis platform for Solana that consolidates on-chain information into clear, actionable views. Users can explore token distribution, monitor price development, and analyze NFT data, all within a single interface. For developers, SolanaFloor Pro unlocks access to additional datasets and deeper insights to support advanced analytics. You can also register an a.sol domain to use the Solana name domain service.
